title: Softening of an Air Ticket Fare Brands Penalty for a Wanderlane Traveller Club Membership
content:
A traveller's standing in the Wanderlane Traveller Club may soften the penalty otherwise withheld on an Air Ticket Fare Brands booking. Two readings of the membership decide it together: the tier bonus the club tier carries, and the qualifying points the membership's own points ledger records over the last 12 months.

## 1. The treatment

1.1 Where the traveller's club tier carries a tier bonus of 75 percent or more and the membership has counted 60000 qualifying points or more over the last 12 months, the figure is halved — taken at 0.5 of itself, which is to say at 50 percent — and cut down to the whole dollar, any part of a dollar being dropped rather than rounded.

1.2 Where the traveller's club tier carries a tier bonus of 25 percent or more and the membership has counted 30000 qualifying points or more over the last 12 months, while either that bonus is below 75 percent or those points are fewer than 60000, the figure is taken at three quarters — 0.75 of itself, which is to say at 75 percent — and cut down to the whole dollar in the same way.

1.3 In every other case no such softening is applied.

## 2. What the points count is read from

The qualifying points counted are the qualifying entries the membership's own ledger carries over that period, never the running total displayed on the membership record. The tier bonus is a property of the club tier held.

## 3. Truth table of the two readings

| Tier bonus | Qualifying points over the last 12 months | Treatment |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 75 percent or more | 60000 or more | halved, cut down to the whole dollar |
| 75 percent or more | 30000 or more but fewer than 60000 | taken at three quarters, cut down to the whole dollar |
| 25 percent or more but below 75 percent | 30000 or more | taken at three quarters, cut down to the whole dollar |
| 25 percent or more but below 75 percent | fewer than 30000 | no such softening |
| below 25 percent | any | no such softening |

## 4. Worked figures, on hypothetical inputs

A figure of 487.60 USD on a membership whose tier bonus is 100 percent and whose ledger records 74000 qualifying points inside the window: the first treatment applies, and half of 487.60 USD is 243.80 USD, cut down to the whole dollar at 243 USD.

The same 487.60 USD on a membership whose tier bonus is 100 percent but whose ledger records 41000 qualifying points: the first treatment fails on the points, the second holds, and three quarters of 487.60 USD is 365.70 USD, cut down to the whole dollar at 365 USD.

The same 487.60 USD on a membership whose tier bonus is 10 percent: neither treatment holds, and no such softening is applied.
